# With great power comes great ...

I used to have a simple and useful project that I could completely understand, coded in HTML + CSS + JavaScript + Alpine with no build step, studiously avoiding heavier dependencies such as React.

Ha Ha!

Now, without much effort or understanding on my part, my agent has added a `Playwright` + `vitest` testing framework and 7 comprehensive testing files to render the code maintainable, rather than just hoping that it continues to "work" over time.

JFC Cursor, do I really have to read all these docs you just produced?
- `QUICK_TEST_GUIDE.md`
- `README_TESTING.md`
- `REFACTORING_ASSESSMENT.md`
- `REFACTORING_PLAN.md`
- `SETUP_TESTING.md`
- `TESTING_PLAN.md`

Please consolidate into a single file (and report back how well you did on this instruction /s )

---

If any test breaks in the future, I guess I'll ask the LLM to fix it.

There's a non-zero likelihood that its proposed solution will be to remove the broken test, and the future agent will assure me that the code remains fundamentally OK.
